newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine police kill 7 in post office heist.
newsitem.headline: Argentine police kill 7 in post office heist.

text.p: Argentine police shot dead seven men on Wednesday after an armed gang attacked a private mail firm's deposit in southern Buenos Aires.
Four police officers were injured, two of them seriously, in a 90-minute shoot-out with the gang, Commissioner Mario Rodriguez of nearby Lanus police station told reporters.
While television showed bodies lying outside the building in the rain, 50 officers searched the surrounding area for gang members who escaped.
There was no immediate word whether they got away with any cash.
